Live reproduction in disposable scratch repos (tracked-specs, wholly-ignored-specs, partially-ignored-specs, and the pre-existing tracked-then-ignored shape) pinned down the exact V7 refusal path an ignored specs/ pathspec takes today, discovered it can abort a legitimate sibling commit in a mixed pathspec, and ruled out a suspected third defect site (git-commit-phase.sh's completeness check) with direct evidence rather than leaving it an open guess.

Carried-figure re-validation found the description's claim 'No ignore-awareness exists anywhere in the commit path today: git check-ignore appears only in check-task-references.sh, check-record-versioning.sh, verify-touched.sh' is false as measured 2026-11-19: those three scripts contain ZERO occurrences of check-ignore, while git-commit-scoped.sh itself already calls 'git check-ignore -q' in its conditional ephemeral :(exclude) injection loop. The gap is real but narrower than stated -- it exists on the POSITIVE-pathspec side only.

The research report missed three surfaces the plan had to add: (1) existing test case U5 in test-git-commit-scoped.sh asserts exit 2 + 'genuinely unstaged' for exactly the shape the new V13 gate reclassifies, so it must be amended in the same phase as the gate; (2) a new lib+test pair requires rows in manifest.json provides.scripts and tests/suite-classification.data or check-extension-docs.sh Rule Q and lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh fail; (3) git-staging-scope.md already carries a '## Positive-Pathspec Ignore-Advisory Hazard' section containing an explicit prohibition ('git check-ignore -q MUST NOT be used to detect this case'), contradicting the report's claim that the file has no gitignore language at all.

Existing test case X5 (ignore-matched file swept up IMPLICITLY inside a non-ignored directory pathspec) is already the exact negative control the new V13 gate needs for the implicit-sweep shape -- it asserts exit 0 and must stay green unchanged, and no new fixture is needed for that dimension.

sync-manifest-scripts.sh derives its on-disk script set via git ls-files, not a filesystem walk; a brand-new untracked file (specs-ignore-lib.sh, test-specs-ignore-lib.sh) was invisible to --write/--check until explicitly git add-ed. Staged both files first, then --write correctly added the two entries and --check reported CHECK PASSED.

The dispatch's directed no-argument 'verify-touched.sh' scoped-tier check at the close of Phase 2 selected test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh (via its own broad suite-class mapping) and that suite FAILED with gate3/gate5 'deployed script content drift' / 'missing scripts' findings. Root cause confirmed by direct inspection of the suite's own fixture comment: it rsync-copies the live agent-system/extensions/ tree (now carrying this task's uncommitted source-store edits) while .claude/ stays a symlink to the real, still-stale deployed tree -- i.e. exactly the source-store/deployed divergence this task's own Phase 6 redeploy exists to resolve, not a regression in the V13 gate logic. All suites directly covering this phase's own edits (test-git-commit-scoped.sh 76/76, test-git-commit-phase.sh 84/84, test-specs-ignore-lib.sh 12/12 from Phase 1) pass in full. Proceeding per the plan's phase ordering (Phase 6 depends on 1-5); re-running the broad touched-path battery after Phase 6's redeploy is expected to clear this.
